main_text.p: telligunt.Primas forte debebamus, mor-dacissimo cuida simulq; mendacissimo A-pologistæ. Quem depexum dedissemus pri-dem, ni hactenus, (quam à nobis san-ctissimi, iidemq; saucy atrocissimis vulne-ribus manes effligatarunt) notis satis de caufis, nonnisi inter amicos Defensio vo-litasset. χρὴ γὰρ αὐτοὺς εἶναι [?]τῆς δὲ πάλαι τὴν δίκην[?]. Interim his fruere, quisquis es Lector, & Vale.

page.notes: The first word "telligunt." is cut at the left edge of the scan; the initial letter is missing and is kept as a fragment. "debebamus" is partly obscured by an ink blot, so the reading is uncertain. The Greek sentence is only partly legible at this scan resolution; the marked words are best readings.
